# Class: `ReferenceGraphicsView`

Handles pan, zoom, and image-edit controls in a neighboring-frame pane.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-viewer.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_viewer.py#L150) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `LinkedGraphicsView`.

Frame navigation and crop Apply/Cancel reach the main window. Cell selection and drawing remain in the current pane; Delete and Backspace in a neighboring pane do not delete a current-frame selection.
